description: This Java source file defines the 'RitaServices' class which provides a set of static methods for handling credit card transactions via a third-party API (RiTA). It includes functions for authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit refund, as well as internal utilities for setting credit card info and building API connection properties.

classes.name: RitaServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling credit card transactions with the RiTA API, including authorization, capture, void, refund, and configuration utilities.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization using the RiTA API, returning a map with transaction results and related info.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Completes a previously authorized transaction by capturing funds, returning capture status and details.

methods.name: ccVoidRelease
methods.description: Void or release a pre-authorization depending on context, using RiTA API.

methods.name: ccVoidRefund
methods.description: Void a refund transaction, reversing prior refund-based credits.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund of a previous transaction, returning refund details and status.

methods.name: ccCreditRefund
methods.description: Performs a credit refund (partial or full) on an authorized transaction.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Populates the RiTA API object with credit card and billing details from the context.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a RitaApi object based on connection properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds and returns properties for connecting to RiTA API based on configuration and context.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount from the context to a string with the configured decimal scale and rounding mode.
